Ryan: Post-deploy smoke checklist:
1) ./scripts/smoke.sh embeddings
2) curl test:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-1","input":"smoke test"}'
```
3) Check panel 'deploy/smoke' for error rate, lat p95, and KV cache miss.

Matt: Rollback command if canary fails:
```
deploy-cli rollback --to-tag=20260320-stable --reason="canary-sla"
```
I'll run this and post logs to #rollback-ops.
